title: Vertical Mobility: Inference from MVP to Trillion-Parameter Workloads — Sitanshu Gupta, CoreWeave
talk_summary: A CoreWeave inference-platform lead describes how they serve serverless and dedicated workloads on one stack, emphasizing KV-cache-aware routing, prefill/decode disaggregation, and offloading KV cache to high-bandwidth storage.

takeaways.what_they_do: The router prioritizes KV cache locality over least-loaded fallback so repeated prefixes hit cache instead of recomputing expensive prefill.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the priority order that we typically take is uh first KV cache locality and then the least loaded fallback
takeaways.numbers: 80 to 90% of input sequence length is the same across requests

takeaways.what_they_do: They exploit that most of the agentic input is identical across turns, so caching that prefix avoids re-prefill; they offload KV cache to fast storage to survive gaps between turns.
takeaways.evidence_quote: reusing the cache across multiple different turns in your agentic workloads between turns also there is lot of um similar prefill

takeaways.what_they_do: They classify workloads by latency SLA (agentic/chat/voice real-time vs batch with loose SLAs) and time-share the same capacity, running batch overnight when real-time load drops.
takeaways.evidence_quote: during US daytime they're running their real-time workloads and from evening to night they want to run batch workloads the same capacity

takeaways.technique: Prefill/decode disaggregation only when it pays
takeaways.what_they_do: They expose PD disaggregation as an optional knob because it is not cheap for every use case, letting the platform choose per workload.
takeaways.evidence_quote: prefilled decode disagregation is not uh cheap for every type of use case

takeaways.technique: Provisioned throughput to dodge noisy-neighbor timeouts
takeaways.what_they_do: Customers who know their traffic profile can reserve carved-out capacity so shared-pool contention doesn't cause timeouts.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you know your traffic profile and if you can let us know about that, we can carve it out specifically for you
